claim_text: Winter storm on a wind farm is several mechanisms; ice accretion is the v0.1 primary candidate.
parameter_or_rule: pathway_id=ice_accretion primary candidate; deferred: ice_with_concurrent_wind, ice_shedding_impact, snow_gravity_load_buildings
permitted_inference: Govern ice accretion separately from shedding, ice+wind and snow on buildings.

claim_text: The legacy winter x wind curves fail zero-input and case-study checks.
reasoning: Logistic curves are not zero at zero ice (nacelle and electrical ~3.3%); predict 17-35% DR at 0.75 in where the cited event shows none; ignore site design.

claim_text: PNNL-33587 does not support the legacy ice fragility numbers.
permitted_inference: Record that the cited fragility figures do not say what the legacy note claims.
prohibited_inference: Citing PNNL as turbine ice fragility.
reasoning: 15/30/45 mm curves are telecom towers on wind speed; Fig.35 is a tension tower near zero below ~60 mm.

claim_text: In February 2021, blade icing caused 48 outages or derates at 41 wind facilities; no physical damage was reported.
permitted_inference: Treat Feb 2021 as a large icing event with availability losses and no reported physical damage.
reasoning: Official report describes protective shutdowns and derates only.

claim_text: No located evidence quantifies physical damage to turbines from ice accretion load.
parameter_or_rule: WT turbine equipment under ice_accretion: withheld (NO_RUNTIME_CURVE)
permitted_inference: Withhold numeric output; not available because evidence is lacking.
reasoning: No turbine structural ice failure located; absence of reports is bounded evidence, not proof (JL checkpoint-2 decision).
update_trigger: Field/claims/work-order evidence of ice-load damage or its absence at known ice thickness.

claim_text: Overhead lines designed for 13 mm of ice withstood about 30-50 mm in 1998.
parameter_or_rule: overhead collection line candidate: median ~3 x design ice, documented only
permitted_inference: Document the first candidate anchor; no runtime curve in v0.1.
prohibited_inference: Activating it without topology and value split.
reasoning: Field withstand of 13-mm-design lines was 30-50 mm; value row merges collection and substation; reference farm assumes buried collection.
update_trigger: Li et al. 2024 coefficients; site overhead share; split value row.

claim_text: Met masts not designed for site ice can collapse.
permitted_inference: Record met masts as the most ice-fragile wind-farm structure; no curve.

claim_text: The one located wind-farm ice damage case was caused mostly by falling ice.
permitted_inference: Route falling-ice damage to the deferred shedding pathway.
prohibited_inference: Charging shedding damage to accretion load.
reasoning: Blue Canyon 2010 damage came mostly from falling ice during thaw.

claim_text: Radial ice thickness at 10 m with concurrent gust is the standard ice-load intensity.
parameter_or_rule: axis: ice_radial_thickness_mm (equivalent uniform radial glaze at 10 m, 25.4 mm cylinder) + ice_concurrent_gust_3s_10m_mps
permitted_inference: Declare the future axis and required capture fields.
prohibited_inference: Treating design ice as a failure threshold.
reasoning: Matches ASCE 7 Ch.10 and the Simple model.

claim_text: Icing downtime and cold shutdowns are business interruption, not physical damage.
parameter_or_rule: excluded: curtailment, icing downtime, freeze-off, cold limits
permitted_inference: Keep business interruption outside the damage curve.
